name: Micro USB to 5 Terminal Add（Shelly Pill)
summary: Screw-terminal breakout for The Pill exposing 3 configurable I/O plus 5 V/GND.

f.supply: 5V DC (from The Pill, or feeds 5V to The Pill)
f.inputs: IO1 multi-purpose (DS18B20 / DHT22 / analog 0-2.5 V / digital) + IO2, IO3 digital 3.3 V I/O

extra.sensors_note: temp/humidity only via external DS18B20 or DHT22 probes (not included)
extra.name_oddity: Listing says 'Micro USB'; KB describes an add-on-interface connector for The Pill (which is USB-C powered)
extra.io_rating_source: IO ratings not in this KB page; The Pill specs: 3.3 V logic, 20 mA

gotchas: Only works with The Pill by Shelly — no radio or MCU of its own
Analog input limited to 0-2.5 V — for 0-30 V add the Analog 0-30V Add-on
3.3 V logic I/O only; to switch small DC loads use the SSR Add-on
Sensors not included — DS18B20/DHT22 probes sold separately
Product name says 'Micro USB' but KB shows a Pill add-on-interface connector; confirm fit
best_for: Hard-wiring DHT22/DS18B20 or reed/digital sensors to The Pill via screw terminals
